note: The mutation harness's own regression test (register decision 221). Mutant A removes the abort listener from every suite's link and rebuilds test_math; mutant B changes nothing but a comment and is judged by abort_listener, which runs test_math among the suites. Until M1-95 the harness restored A's file but rebuilt only B's targets, so B was judged against a test_math still built without the listener, and was 'caught' -- M1-90's two kills for the wrong reason, recreated on purpose. Since M1-95 the harness rebuilds A's targets after restoring, and B survives, as declared. The order is the test: A must come first.

mutants.name: the suites no longer link the listener
a comment only, judged against the programs mutant A rebuilt
mutants.replace: LISTENER = "AbortWithoutADialog"  # M1-95: a comment changes nothing
mutants.why: Equivalent by construction: a Python comment changes no behaviour. It exists to be judged right after mutant A, and it survives only if the harness rebuilt test_math after restoring A's file (M1-95, register decision 221).
